ideas.name: far from settlement at 10:00, continue
ideas.why: a session already 0.4 of its usual range from settlement by 10:00 is a trend day; the move keeps going

ideas.name: first time 0.3 range from settlement, continue
ideas.why: the first time in a session that price gets 0.3 of its usual range from settlement (after 09:00) marks the day breaking away

ideas.name: flip1 far from settlement its way
ideas.why: flips that point the way a trend day has already gone from settlement
